title: Amazing villages to discover
text:
We found this office in Seville, very close to the Cathedral, and decided to book several tours with them, including this one. We didn’t know much about the White Villages, and since we’d had such a fantastic experience on the previous tours, we thought it was the perfect opportunity to discover them. Once again… we weren’t disappointed!

Daniel is incredibly flexible. He gave us a great price for this tour and arranged an excellent guide for us. During the drive, he shared lots of interesting information and conversation, and at each stop we had plenty of free time to explore on our own.

title: Fantastic day in Andalusia
text: Wonderful experience all around. The villages were beautiful and interesting. Rich history, excellent ham and wine, and fantastic vistas. Our tour guide was flexible with time and very knowledgeable about each location, with great recommendations for each stop. It was an excellent and relaxing way to wrap up our trip to Andalusia.

author: Happiness827005

title: Excellent day touring the White Villages
text:
Our guide for the day was Daniel and he was excellent.  He knows the countryside and his history of the White Villages.  Very informative and educational.  He showed us the best places to take pictures and where to talk to the locals.  And, the best places to eat in each town.  It was a full day with an early start but it made sense to get out of Seville before the morning rush hour and back before the afternoon one started.  
If you're interested in the history of this region and seeing the sites, I can't recommend this tour and Daniel strongly enough.  
Well done Sir, it was a fantastic day

title: 100% recommended
